# Divesh Gupta

> Security researcher, founder, and game developer. Computer science at the University of Georgia, class of 2027. Based in Athens, Georgia.

Divesh Gupta does security research, builds tools, and makes games.

## Experience

- VaultPoint Systems, Cofounder (2026 to now). Products: Zetadeck, RiskGuard. https://vaultpoint.systems
- UGA CyberArch, R&D Lead (2025 to now). Cybersecurity clinic at the Carl Vinson Institute of Government.
- The Hack Pack, Founding President (2024 to now). UGA's applied cybersecurity club, 300 members. https://thehackpack.org
- UGA Game Builders Club, Web Dev Officer. Built the club site. https://gamebuildersclub.com

## Security research

- Firmware Zero-Day Pipeline (2026): automated vulnerability research for router firmware under QEMU. Three zero-days, one in coordinated disclosure.
- Alpha (2026): autonomous CTF solving framework. 2nd in US/Canada, CSAW CTF Qualifiers 2026.
- ESP32 Gateway Security Research (2026): co-authored paper, CSAW Embedded Security Challenge finalist.

## Competitions

- NCAE CyberGames 2025: 2nd place, Southeast regionals.
- Crimson Defense CTF 2025: 4th place.
- National Cyber League 2021 to 2026: 100th percentile individual, Spring 2025.
